title: Land Rover — Iraqi Kurdistan
summary: A multi-location automotive photography project across Iraqi Kurdistan, bringing Land Rover's vehicles into the region's distinctive landscapes and architectural settings.

blocks.body:
The objective was to create an automotive photography collection that connected Land Rover's vehicles with the distinctive geography and character of Iraqi Kurdistan.

Rather than relying on conventional automotive environments, the creative direction placed the vehicles within real landscapes — from historical sites and mountain roads to rugged terrain and dramatic rock formations.

The photoshoot brought together the Range Rover Sport and Defender lineup, using location, composition, light, and colour to establish a cinematic visual language.

Each location was selected to create a relationship between the vehicles' design and the surrounding environment.

The resulting photography collection reflects both the character of the vehicles and the identity of the region in which they were photographed.

The art direction focused on creating images that felt authentic to their locations while maintaining the visual standards expected of a premium automotive brand.

Natural landscapes, architectural structures, vehicle positioning, and considered colour treatment helped establish a consistent photographic direction across the different locations.

blocks.caption: Location 1 — Historical ruins, Range Rover Sport exteriors & interior details
Location 2 — Mountain roads & off-road, full Defender lineup
The Tunnel — Defender convoy, night run

blocks.body:
The project demonstrates how location can become an active part of automotive storytelling.

By treating the landscape as more than a backdrop, the photography creates a stronger connection between product, place, and visual identity.
